title: The Mentalist — home / investigation board
brief: Main screen of a personal, spoiler-safe desktop database of The Mentalist: progress gate, case list with silhouettes on solved cases, 3D map with Red John smiley pins, and entry points to characters, the Red John arc and the non-canon Geek/Fans section. 100% Mentalist style: palette, typography, everything.

artboards.title: CBI case file
artboards.tradeoff: Most thematic and tactile (manila folders, stamps, typed labels); denser and more decorative, paper textures may tire over long sessions

artboards.title: Red room
artboards.tradeoff: Map-first and dramatic, red reserved for Red John; dark and intense, less comfortable for long reading and other states cannot use red

artboards.title: Sacramento daylight
artboards.tradeoff: Calm, editorial and the most readable (warm daylight, serif, whitespace); least thriller punch, the menace has to come from the smiley alone
